```{=html}
<style>
  /* ==========================================================================
     1. 전역 레이아웃 및 카드 프레임 (Investment 페이지와 100% 동치)
     ========================================================================== */
  .hobbies-container {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin: 2rem 0;
  }

  .large-project-card {
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 28px;
    padding: 2.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  }
  .large-project-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  }

  .card-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #86868b;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  .large-project-card .card-main-title {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
  }

  .card-visual-zone {
    width: 100%;
    background: #f5f5f7;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .card-tags-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .tag-chip {
    background: #e8e8ed;
    color: #424245;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .card-description {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #424245;
    margin: 0;
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     2. Matrix 01 . Endurance Lab 전용 모던 CSS 바 차트 및 타이포그래피 튜닝
     ========================================================================== */
  .run-chart-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .run-chart-box {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
  }

  /* 🌟 막대그래프 축선 제어: 중앙 정렬 및 여백(gap) 인프라 주입 */
  .run-bar-axis {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1.1rem; /* 막대 사이의 세련된 공기감 부여 */
    align-items: flex-end;
    width: 100%;
    height: 190px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed;
    padding-bottom: 4px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .run-bar-column {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 11%; /* 기둥 두께를 날씬하게 깎아 여백 수율 극대화 */
    height: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
  
  /* 🌟 직관적인 height 기반 무결성 채우기 */
  .run-bar-fill {
    width: 100%;
    background-color: #E5E5EA;
    border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0;
    transition: height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
  }
  .run-bar-fill.active {
    background-color: #FF2D55 !important; /* 러닝 테마의 열정적인 핑크-레드 액센트 */
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255,45,85,0.2);
  }
  .run-bar-label {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: #86868b;
    margin-top: 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* 🌟 메인 피규어 폰트 아이덴티티 락인 (SF Mono 동치) */
  .run-pb-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1rem;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .run-pb-card {
    background: #f5f5f7;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .run-pb-label {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #86868b;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }
  .run-pb-value {
    font-family: "SF Mono", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace !important; /* 🌟 메인 페이지의 정밀 무드 이식 */
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     3. Matrix 02 . Travel & Photography 전용 스쿼드 스타일 (순정 복원)
     ========================================================================== */
  .squad-container {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  .squad-master-kpi {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    color: #1d1d1f;
  }
  .squad-master-kpi span {
    font-family: "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace !important; /* 🌟 숫자 고정폭 통합 */
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .squad-matrix-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .squad-country-block {
    background: #f5f5f7;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .squad-header-title {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    color: #1d1d1f;
  }
  .squad-embedded-flag {
    width: 20px;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 2px;
    object-fit: cover;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .squad-indent-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
  }
  .squad-indent-item {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: #515154;
    padding-left: 0.5rem;
    border-left: 1.5px solid #d2d2d7;
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     4. Matrix 03 . Squad Command 전용 고정폭 타이포 및 아키텍처 튜닝 (순정 복원)
     ========================================================================== */
  .squad-board-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1.2rem;
  }
  .squad-command-kpi {
    background: #0f172a;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }
  .squad-kpi-title {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #94a3b8;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }
  .squad-kpi-value {
    font-family: "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace !important; /* 🌟 가동 시간 서체 통합 */
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #38bdf8;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  .squad-grid-system {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .squad-command-block {
    background: #f8fafc;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  }
  .squad-command-title {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1e293b;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .squad-command-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.6rem;
  }
  .squad-command-item {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    color: #475569;
    padding-left: 0.8rem;
    border-left: 2px solid #cbd5e1;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     5. 미디어 쿼리 반응형 제어선 (안정성 확보)
     ========================================================================== */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .run-chart-grid, .squad-grid-system { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
    .card-visual-zone { height: auto !important; }
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .large-project-card { padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 20px; }
    .card-main-title { font-size: 1.4rem; }
  }
</style>
```
